findings: Default near-budget mode applies only above 300; the target lower bound is ceil(0.7 * cap), the upper cap remains inclusive. Invalid budgets cannot silently become unlimited. Blank, <=300 and explicit uniform mode select uniformly from the effective eligible pool.

The actual filtered pool and no-repeat rule are applied before grouping. With both groups available, a Fisher-Yates shuffled five-slot bag supplies exactly four preferred and one cheaper slot per completed stable-band cycle; the meal is chosen uniformly within its current group. Reports and SPEC qualify the quota and do not claim every sliding five draws has the ratio.

When no target-band meal remains, the fallback is ceil(0.8 * actual maximum eligible price) through that maximum. The UI identifies the missing target range and actual replacement band. One-group, sole-meal, empty-pool and no-repeat conditions do not force unavailable quota slots or relax dietary/budget constraints.

The configuration key includes filters, mode, avoid-repeat, dishes and sorted favorites. Rendering resets the quota on actual configuration transitions, including away-and-back changes; presentation sorting, pagination and comparison are excluded. Clearing history explicitly resets the bag. The result policy note is tied to its dish and exact draw configuration, while current-policy summary is recomputed separately.

Sorting uses copied arrays and does not mutate the source catalog. Storage keeps its original key, version, catalog revision, dishes/favorites/history fields and migration path; preference/cycle state is session-only. No runtime model, SQL or network service was introduced by this change.

Regression source contains the original behavior coverage plus nine budget groups, including 200/300/301 boundaries, 800/1500/3000 quotas, fallback/diet, uniform/unlimited reachability, no-repeat, reset and presentation invariance, and stale-note handling. Each final DOCX has eight embedded screenshots matching all eight final PNGs, including the new budget-priority image. Root reports eight rendered pages for each document; this reviewer checked embedded content and source identity only, not page layout.

Recovery values 0/35/1 and comparison arithmetic 1300/400/excess1200 remain consistent. Four generated images are illustrative, accessibility claims are limited to selected controls and nine color pairs, and no human timing/satisfaction, whole-site accessibility certification or grade is invented.
